preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 4 and all(c.isdigit() for c in parts) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 50 for x in parts)
preconditions.description: The input consists of a single line containing exactly four space-separated integers n_1, n_2, k_1, k_2, each between 1 and 50 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'First' if n_1 > n_2 else stdout.strip() == 'Second'
postconditions.description: The output is 'First' if n_1 is strictly greater than n_2, and 'Second' otherwise, reflecting that the first player wins if and only if they have more balls than the second player, given optimal play.
